content.short: Remittance and credit card product for families across borders.
content.description: Pomelo is a US fintech that reinvents remittances by combining money transfers with credit cards, letting families send money abroad while building credit at home. A sender in the United States opens a Pomelo account with a credit line and issues cards to family members overseas — initially focused on the Philippines — so recipients can spend directly, with no transfer fees and rewards points earned along the way. Banking services are provided through a partner bank, and Pomelo settles the international leg through payment networks like Thunes. By turning remittances into instant, card-based spending backed by credit rather than slow, fee-heavy wires, Pomelo targets immigrant families who regularly support relatives abroad and want a cheaper, more rewarding way to do it.
content.meta: Pomelo blends fee-free remittances with credit cards for families abroad. Discover Pomelo and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
